title: Product Listing Optimization: How To Get Your Products Seen (2025) - Shopify

facts.fact: Per a Statista statistic cited on the page, 36% of all product searches start on third-party channels such as Google Shopping or Amazon.
facts.quote: where [36%](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1034209/global-product-search-online-sources/) of all product searches start

facts.fact: The Shopify article 'Product Listing Optimization: How To Get Your Products Seen' is dated January 17, 2025 and is listed as a 9-minute read.
